data.narrative:
Kipu Quantum is a seed-stage quantum computing company that has raised approximately $14.5M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 11 identified peers: 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Valuation was derived using stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. This method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage transitions, yielding an implied valuation of $36M. The peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient comparable data points at the same stage or adjacent stages within the quantum computing universe; while eight same-sector peers exist, none of the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier) produced three or more datapoints.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $31M to $42M, with a median point of $36M. The range reflects conservative (low) and optimistic (high) interpretations of stage-appropriate progression. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer benchmarking within seed-stage quantum, limiting cross-validation of the stage-progression multiplier, and the nascent, heterogeneous nature of the quantum computing market, where comparable metrics remain inconsistently reported across the peer set.
